---
title: "NF_scRank"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: flatly
    orientation: rows
    logo: lab-logo.png
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  merged_obj: "merged_obj.RDS"
  target: "Brd4"
  n_cores: 1
---

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(Seurat)
library(scRank)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggpubr)

obj_base   <- readRDS(params$merged_obj)
target_vec <- strsplit(params$target, ";")[[1]]
celltypes  <- names(obj_base@net)

objs              <- list()
tabelas           <- list()
top_ct_por_target <- list()
bot_ct_por_target <- list()

get_cor_val <- function(rede, tgt, regulado) {
  genes <- strsplit(tgt, ";")[[1]]
  vals  <- sapply(genes, function(g) {
    if (g %in% rownames(rede) && regulado %in% colnames(rede)) abs(rede[g, regulado]) else NA_real_
  })
  mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}

for (tgt in target_vec) {
  obj             <- obj_base
  obj@para$target <- tgt
  obj             <- rank_celltype(obj, n.core = params$n_cores)

  top_ct <- obj@cell_type_rank |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rank)) |>
    rownames() |>
    _[1]

  bot_ct <- obj@cell_type_rank |>
    dplyr::arrange(rank) |>
    rownames() |>
    _[1]

  top_ct_por_target[[tgt]] <- top_ct

  # init_mod: zoom=TRUE pode falhar quando o target fica num sub-módulo menor que
  # min_ModuleSize após a re-clusterização (cutree(k=0) → erro). Fallback progressivo:
  # 1. padrão (zoom=TRUE, min=10); 2. zoom=FALSE com min=5; 3. zoom=FALSE com min=3.
  obj <- tryCatch(
    init_mod(obj, top_celltype = top_ct),
    error = function(e) {
      message("[nf_scrank] init_mod padrão falhou para '", tgt, "': ", conditionMessage(e),
              "\n  → tentando zoom=FALSE, min_ModuleSize=5")
      tryCatch(
        init_mod(obj, top_celltype = top_ct, zoom = FALSE, min_ModuleSize = 5),
        error = function(e2) {
          message("[nf_scrank] init_mod zoom=FALSE min=5 falhou: ", conditionMessage(e2),
                  "\n  → tentando zoom=FALSE, min_ModuleSize=3")
          tryCatch(
            init_mod(obj, top_celltype = top_ct, zoom = FALSE, min_ModuleSize = 3),
            error = function(e3) {
              message("[nf_scrank] init_mod falhou em todos os fallbacks para '", tgt,
                      "': ", conditionMessage(e3), "\n  → target pulado.")
              NULL
            }
          )
        }
      )
    }
  )

  if (is.null(obj)) next  # pula target se init_mod falhou completamente

  bot_ct_por_target[[tgt]] <- bot_ct
  objs[[tgt]]  <- obj

  tabelas[[tgt]] <- list()
  for (ct in celltypes) {
    rede <- obj@net[[ct]]
    df <- data.frame(
      Target    = tgt,
      Regulated = names(obj@para$gene_clusters),
      Modulo    = paste0("M", obj@para$gene_clusters),
      CellType  = ct,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ) |>
      dplyr::filter(Regulated %in% obj@para$subnet_node, Regulated != tgt) |>
      dplyr::rowwise() |>
      dplyr::mutate(`abs(cor)` = get_cor_val(rede, tgt, Regulated)) |>
      dplyr::ungroup() |>
      dplyr::mutate(.mod_num = as.integer(sub("M", "", Modulo))) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.mod_num, dplyr::desc(`abs(cor)`)) |>
      dplyr::select(-.mod_num)

    tabelas[[tgt]][[ct]] <- df
  }
}

tabela_completa <- dplyr::bind_rows(unlist(tabelas, recursive = FALSE))
```

# Mapas de Rede {icon="diagram-2"}

## Row {.tabset}

```{r network-tabs, results='asis'}
# Triple backticks não podem aparecer literalmente dentro de um code chunk no
# Quarto — o preprocessor os interpreta como fechamento de fence. Por isso o
# template é construído via paste0 com backticks gerados em runtime.
f <- paste(rep("`", 3), collapse = "")

net_template <- paste0(
  "### {{ct}}\n\n",
  f, "{r net-{{idx}}, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}\n",
  'plot_net(objs[["{{tgt}}"]], mode = "network", celltype = "{{ct}}")\n',
  f, "\n\n"
)

idx <- 0L
for (tgt in names(objs)) {   # itera apenas sobre targets que tiveram init_mod com sucesso
  for (ct in celltypes) {
    idx     <- idx + 1L
    expanded <- knitr::knit_expand(text = net_template, tgt = tgt, ct = ct, idx = idx)
    cat(knitr::knit_child(text = expanded, quiet = TRUE))
  }
}
```

## Row {.tabset}

```{r delta-cor-tabs, results='asis'}
# Painel Δcor: |cor_top_ct| - |cor_bot_ct| para os genes da subnet (order_gene).
# Evidencia quais genes e módulos têm correlação diferencial entre o celltype mais
# afetado (top_ct, maior rank de perturbação) e o menos afetado (bot_ct).
# Escala divergente: positivo = correlação mais forte em top_ct, negativo = em bot_ct.

f <- paste(rep("`", 3), collapse = "")

delta_template <- paste0(
  "### {{tgt}}\n\n",
  f, "{r delta-{{idx}}, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}\n",
  ".delta_plot_nf_scrank(objs[[\"{{tgt}}\"]], top_ct = top_ct_por_target[[\"{{tgt}}\"]],",
  " bot_ct = bot_ct_por_target[[\"{{tgt}}\"]])\n",
  f, "\n\n"
)

.delta_plot_nf_scrank <- function(obj, top_ct, bot_ct) {
  genes   <- obj@para$order_gene
  gc      <- obj@para$gene_clusters[genes]
  tgt     <- obj@para$target

  net_top <- abs(obj@net[[top_ct]][genes, genes])
  net_bot <- abs(obj@net[[bot_ct]][genes, genes])
  delta   <- net_top - net_bot  # rownames/colnames = genes

  # Rownames: mostra apenas o target (padrão visual de plot_net)
  id_other <- which(!genes %in% tgt)
  id_tgt   <- which(genes %in% tgt)
  rownames(delta)[id_other] <- ""
  rownames(delta)[id_tgt]   <- paste0("<", tgt)

  # Anotação de módulos (colnames mantidos como gene names para o match)
  if (length(unique(gc)) < 2) {
    nM <- rep("Module1", length(gc))
  } else {
    nM <- do.call(c, lapply(seq_len(length(unique(gc))), function(i) {
      rep(paste0("Module", i), as.integer(table(sort(gc)))[i])
    }))
  }
  ann_col <- data.frame(Module = factor(nM))
  rownames(ann_col) <- genes
  mat_colors <- list(Module = ggpubr::get_palette("lancet", length(unique(nM))))
  names(mat_colors$Module) <- unique(nM)

  gaps  <- which(diff(sort(gc)) != 0)
  lim   <- max(abs(range(delta, na.rm = TRUE)), 1e-9)
  bk    <- seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101)
  cols  <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#6565FF", "white", "forestgreen"))(100)

  # Usa ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap para consistência visual com plot_net(mode="heatmap")
  suppressWarnings(ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
    delta,
    cluster_rows         = FALSE, cluster_cols         = FALSE,
    show_rownames        = TRUE,  show_colnames        = FALSE,
    breaks               = bk,    color                = cols,
    border_color         = NA,
    name                 = "Δcor",
    annotation_col       = ann_col,
    annotation_colors    = mat_colors,
    annotation_names_col = FALSE,
    annotation_legend    = TRUE,
    gaps_row             = gaps,  gaps_col             = gaps,
    main                 = paste0("Δ|cor|  =  |", top_ct, "|  −  |", bot_ct, "|")
  ))
}

idx_d <- 200L
for (tgt in names(objs)) {
  idx_d   <- idx_d + 1L
  expanded <- knitr::knit_expand(text = delta_template, tgt = tgt, idx = idx_d)
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = expanded, quiet = TRUE))
}
```
